policy.scope: Exploratory scientific classification only. No production gate or tolerance changes. Window changes must persist and full residuals must be small for a steady claim; stable fluctuation statistics are needed for a stationary-unsteady claim.
policy.discretization_context: Cutoff-v1 reference errors and coarse/fine differences in the existing report motivate a stringent drift screen, not a proof of continuum accuracy. Residuals are reported dimensionally and with fixed H=2 normalization. Reference error remains separate from time-window drift.
policy.window_sensitivity: Compare primary adjacent .5 windows and combined 1.0 windows once available. Secondary .1/.2 windows diagnose current drift without authorizing an early persistent-settling claim.

selection: Latest completed endpoint with three preceding endpoints separated by exactly .5; selection uses availability only. Also retain the latest completed report.
scope: Common Ustar=.4,K0=.5105080131,E0=.0726358333,p0=.16,V=24 physical L2 panels; epsilon changes only on common z>=2. Full spatial epsilon residual uses the actual entire outer transport space. Negative classifications do not depend on omitting the lower outer epsilon region.
legacy_context: The older long-time report used a broader 1e-3 exploratory field screen. This comparison explicitly uses the fixed H=2 common normalization and the supplied policy for all six cases; it does not silently substitute H-dependent native residual scales or infer stationarity from endpoint samples.
